name: locus-tag-bench
description: Benchmark for tasks involving locus tags (identifiers for genomic features), assessing models' ability to recognize, map, or generate locus-tag-style identifiers in biological text. Typically used to evaluate extraction, normalization, or formatting of locus tag strings from text or metadata. Useful for testing domain-specific sequence/identifier handling in language models.
reputation: Niche dataset with limited but relevant adoption among bioinformatics/ML practitioners working on genomics text processing.
